edits.why: Bump go directive from 1.22 to 1.24 so Go's default key exchanges include X25519MLKEM768 once the curve pin is removed.
Replace the P-256-only CurvePreferences with a hybrid-first list: X25519MLKEM768, then X25519 and P-256 for classical-only clients.
Update the test if it asserts the old P-256 pin, so it verifies the hybrid-first curve list instead.
Change ssl_ecdh_curve from prime256v1 to X25519MLKEM768:X25519:prime256v1 so the edge negotiates hybrid while classical clients still connect.
Move the build image to golang:1.27-trixie and the runtime image to nginx:1.29-trixie so the runtime OpenSSL 3.5 ships ML-KEM.

summary: Enable hybrid ML-KEM key exchange: pin X25519MLKEM768 first (with X25519/P-256 fallback) in the Go listener and nginx, and move the runtime base images to Debian trixie so OpenSSL 3.5 provides ML-KEM; RS256 and cert verification untouched.
